initiate.title: Initiate
initiate.description:
+10 Max Mana
Spend 5 points in this tree to open the Schools. Pick any two Schools. Archmage opens at 20 points spent.

meditation.title: Meditation
meditation.description: Crouch still for 2 seconds to double your mana regeneration.

glyph_economy.title: Glyph Economy
glyph_economy.description: Ars Nouveau spells cost 10% less mana.

witchsight.title: Witchsight
witchsight.description: While holding a spellbook or staff, invisible creatures within 16 blocks glow.

spellbound_scavenger.title: Spellbound Scavenger
spellbound_scavenger.description: Creatures slain by your spells have a 5% chance to drop Arcane Essence.

technomancer.title: Technomancer
technomancer.description: Ars spells that contain any Ars Technica glyph (Press, Polish, Whirl, Carve, Fuse...) cost 25% less mana.

pyromancy_attunement.title: Pyromancy: Attunement
pyromancy_attunement.description:
Requires 5 points spent in this tree. Pick any two Schools; the rest lock.
+8% Fire Spell Power
+1 Ars Fire power (Ars Fire glyphs deal +1 damage)

pyromancy_resilience.title: Pyromancy: Resilience
pyromancy_resilience.description:
+5% Fire Magic Resistance
-5% damage from Ars Fire spells

pyromancy_efficiency.title: Pyromancy: Efficiency
pyromancy_efficiency.description:
Ars Fire glyphs cost 5% less mana.
Focus Resonance: while an Ars Elemental Focus of Fire is equipped, +10% Fire Spell Power and +10% Mana Regeneration.

pyromancy_unique.title: Pyromancy: Ember Heart
pyromancy_unique.description:
Requires both nodes below it.
-50% fire damage taken; creatures you kill with fire drop cooked food.

pyromancy_mastery.title: Pyromancy: Mastery
pyromancy_mastery.description:
+7% Fire Spell Power, +5% Fire Magic Resistance
+1 Ars Fire power

pyromancy_b1.title: Pyromancy: Cinderborn
pyromancy_b1.description: Ember Heart: fire damage taken is reduced by 75% instead of 50%.

pyromancy_b2.title: Pyromancy: Kindled Soul
pyromancy_b2.description: While you are on fire, +10% Fire Spell Power.

pyromancy_b3.title: Pyromancy: Magma Skin
pyromancy_b3.description: Ember Heart also halves lava damage.

pyromancy_capstone.title: Pyromancy: Inferno
pyromancy_capstone.description:
Requires either branch below it.
Creatures you kill with fire burst into flame, setting enemies within 6 blocks on fire for 8 seconds. Enemies it sets on fire spread it again when they die.

stormcalling_b3.title: Stormcalling: Wet Wired
stormcalling_b3.description: Stormborn also works while you stand in water.

stormcalling_capstone.title: Stormcalling: Thunderlord
